clock: mandatory read_time captured with each batch before advancing
memory: last ten complete timestamped turn-output batches; empty state
history_order: oldest to newest; initial clock-only batch replaced after first turn

function.name: read_north_queue
function.description: North Road is the northern approach to a single four-way intersection shared by North, South, East and West Roads. Returns the number of cars stopped and waiting on North Road before its stop line. Excludes moving cars and cars already crossing the intersection. All tool outputs in a turn share the observation time recorded on their history batch.

function.name: set_north_signal
function.description: North Road is the northern approach to a single four-way intersection shared by North, South, East and West Roads. Sets the always-lit traffic signal facing drivers waiting on North Road to enter the intersection, not drivers on another road. At simulation time zero it displays green. The selected colour remains displayed until another call changes it. This tool changes only this signal; the other three signals are unchanged. There is no automatic colour sequence. Returns the displayed colour at the batch's recorded observation time.

function.name: read_time
function.description: Returns elapsed simulation time in seconds at the instant of the call. A mandatory reading is included with every completed turn's tool-output batch, including turns with no model-selected calls. The batch timestamp is its observation time, not the time of the later decision receiving it. Simulation advances five seconds between model decisions and does not advance between tool calls within a turn.
